ask: can u work out what each of us owes, rent is 1900 and utils 140, and make sure it adds up
sentence: Splits a fixed monthly rent across rooms and shares utilities equally, shows what each person owes, and checks that the total matches rent plus utilities.
use_when: Housemates need to work out what each person owes for rent and utilities
Rent differs by room and people want to move amounts between rooms until it feels fair
A group wants a check that individual shares add up to the full bill
People want to pick their own room and opt in or out of utilities
dont_use_when: Splitting a one-off restaurant or trip bill with itemised expenses
Tracking who paid whom over time or settling running balances
Splitting by percentages or income rather than fixed room rents
